_doc: Sprint V15 evaluation grid, FROZEN BEFORE any trial (this file is committed before the variants are generated and is not modified afterwards). Automated measures are computed identically for every variant ; the 0-5 'subjective' criteria are scored by the model and are NOT a human validation.

automated_measures.method: Render each variant from above at the same size, crop the map interior (frame and title excluded), classify every pixel with the SAME Lab prototypes as the reference (reference_prototypes in HYRULE_REQUIREMENTS.json), resample to the reference grid, compare with the reference class map.
automated_measures.pixel_accuracy: share of map cells whose class equals the reference class (after merging *_hi classes into their family)
automated_measures.mean_IoU: mean over the families water, grass, forest, desert, stone, snow, mesa_rust of the intersection-over-union with the reference
automated_measures.landmark_error: mean distance (fraction of map width) between the centroid of each landmark region in the variant and in the reference (landmarks listed in HYRULE_REQUIREMENTS.json, measured on the reference, not invented)
automated_measures.aspect_error: |width/height of the variant map - reference aspect| / reference aspect

subjective_criteria_0_to_5.geographic_recognition: is Hyrule (BotW) recognisable WITHOUT the title ? are the big regions where the reference puts them ?
subjective_criteria_0_to_5.fidelity_to_reference: contours, proportions, water bodies compared with the reference picture
subjective_criteria_0_to_5.relief_quality: progressive, readable mountains/cliffs, not blocks put on a plate
subjective_criteria_0_to_5.colour_harmony: natural palette, no dominant brown, water/land differentiated
subjective_criteria_0_to_5.region_legibility: plains, forests, deserts, rocky zones, snow distinct at normal viewing distance
subjective_criteria_0_to_5.frame_and_title: frame secondary to the map, title discreet or absent

go_artistic: recognisable without the title AND big regions correctly positioned (landmark_error <= 0.10 and pixel_accuracy >= 0.55 on the reference grid) ; the model-assigned scores are indicative only and a human visual validation is required before any reference is frozen in CI
go_technical: 0 collisions, 0 disconnected parts, 0 islands, 0 unsupported, no new critical structural defect (one-stud / articulation counts not worse than V14 by more than 25 %), identical rebuild SHA, baselines in ci/reference_hashes.json untouched
stop_rules: max 3 approaches (A current, B guided, C hybrid) and 3 justified correction cycles in total
